# Sources and provenance

This skill is an original, consolidated audit framework. It does not require remote sources at runtime.

Its coverage was informed by the concepts and review areas in these public references:

- Microsoft `frontend-design-review`:
  https://github.com/microsoft/skills/tree/main/.github/skills/frontend-design-review

- Vercel Web Interface Guidelines:
  https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines
  https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/web-design-guidelines

- W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2:
  https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

- WAI Understanding WCAG 2.2:
  https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/understanding/

Project-specific requirements, Figma libraries, Storybook documentation, internal design systems, brand standards, and regulatory obligations should take precedence when supplied.

Do not use this technical audit as a substitute for legal advice or a formal conformance determination.
